title: dependency record
description: Frontmatter of docs/dependencies/<crate>.md: the living investigation record for one Cargo dependency (#190). The shape is checked here by the schema family; the agnosticism suite holds the record set in bijection with Cargo.toml (every dependency has a record, every record names a dependency) and checks the fields no schema can — crate equals the file stem, scope names the declaring table, version_req is Cargo's requirement string verbatim.

crate.description: The crate name as Cargo.toml spells it; equals the record's file stem.

scope.description: The Cargo table that declares it: [dependencies], [dev-dependencies], [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies], [target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies].

version_req.description: The version requirement exactly as Cargo.toml carries it ("4.5", "0.13.4").

status.description: approved: investigated and accepted; provisional: accepted pending a named follow-up in the record.

tracker.description: The tracker issue that carried the investigation, when one did.
